statement: In goal_cejel_v27_a1_gaps_2026-11-03, a full test suite was started in the background, and then the code and a test were edited in place to time a reader without its work budget and to print the timings. The suite was importing files from that same working tree, so its result could no longer be told apart from the temporary edits, and it had to be stopped and run again. One planned command also ended in `git checkout -- <file>` to undo the probe edit. That would have thrown away the budget change too, which was not yet committed; a permission prompt stopped it, not foresight. Rules: commit before any temporary probe edit, and undo the probe by editing it back, never by checking out the file. Do not run a suite or a measurement against a working tree you are about to edit. Treat any run that overlapped an edit as void.
